# CodeGuppy

> > CodeGuppy is a free, web-based JavaScript and p5.js platform designed to make computer science education accessible and engaging for middle and high school students.

CodeGuppy provides a complete coding education ecosystem built on JavaScript and p5.js, featuring interactive lessons, curriculum materials, and creative coding projects. The platform is designed for classroom use, coding clubs, and independent learners, with resources for educators and students across K-12.

## Getting Started

- [CodeGuppy Home](https://codeguppy.com): Free JavaScript & p5.js platform for K-12 coding education
- [About CodeGuppy](https://codeguppy.com/about.html): Web-based JavaScript & p5.js platform for classrooms

## Learning Resources

- [JavaScript Curriculum](https://codeguppy.com/curriculum.html): Illustrated JavaScript curriculum in PowerPoint for middle & high schools
- [Video Lessons](https://codeguppy.com/videos.html): JavaScript video lessons & tutorials for students & teachers
- [Free Downloads](https://codeguppy.com/download.html): Free downloadable JavaScript course & coding resources by Tariq Rashid
- [Blog](https://codeguppy.com/blog/index.html): CS & coding education articles for students, teachers & parents

## Educator Resources

- [For Educators](https://codeguppy.com/educators.html): Teacher resources for CodeGuppy classroom setup & coding club activities
- [Hour of Code](https://codeguppy.com/hourofcode.html): Hour of Code resources: Draw with Code book & JavaScript activities
